description:
You can purchase the CLC Digital Library and Video Archive, which includes video presentations, panelist slides, and a comprehensive digital legal library related to the Covid Litigation Conference (CLC) 2023. This package is available for $195 and can be obtained at the following link: https://vacsafety.circle.so/c/education-mandate-panel/Show more If you'd like to get a taste of what the conference offered, you can watch a sample of the Covid Litigation Conference (2023).
The Covid Litigation Conference 2023 (CLC 2023) was an outstanding event that brought together trial lawyers who are actively involved in advancing Covid-19-related lawsuits. The conference provided numerous networking opportunities and engaging panel discussions led by attorneys experienced in Covid-19 litigation.
For those who participated as speakers or purchased tickets for the conference, they received access to video presentations, panelist slides, and a comprehensive digital legal library. Now, this valuable digital package is available for purchase to both attorneys and the general public for $195.
Speaking on the censorship panel digital preview: Attorneys Mark Meuser, Mary Holland, Deanna Pollard Sacks, and Kathryn Huwig.
You can find the full CLC program booklet at this link: https://vacsafety.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/64270cc5354aab0716ecf561_booklet.pdf Show less
